$schema: Aluplan token source. Single source of truth. Edit here, then run: node scripts/build-tokens.mjs

aboutEditorial.$description: Editorial line-height retained from the existing about page.

iconOpticalOffset.$description: Optical vertical alignment for the playlist icon; preserves its existing position.

smallOpticalOffset.$description: Small optical alignment offset used by compact icons and metadata.

mediaControlInset.$description: Offset for the video card zoom control; preserves the existing position.

playlistStickyOffset.$description: Sticky top offset for the playlist sidebar; preserves the existing position.

referencesStickyOffset.$description: Sticky top offset for the references filter; preserves the existing position.

storyStickyOffset.$description: Sticky top offset for the about story sidebar; preserves the existing position.

jsxTight.$description: Shared sizing for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

jsxCompact.$description: Shared sizing for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

jsxRegular.$description: Shared sizing for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

jsxDense.$description: Shared sizing for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

jsxComfortable.$description: Shared sizing for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

jsxWide.$description: Shared sizing for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

jsxSection.$description: Shared sizing for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

jsxSectionWide.$description: Shared sizing for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

jsxEmptyStateBlock.$description: Shared sizing for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

jsxSectionInset.$description: Shared inset for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

jsxOffset.$description: Shared offset for existing application JSX; preserves the current rendered value across themes and modes.

checkboxMax.$description: Upper bound so checkboxes stay square in every theme (structural: must not read as radio)

strokeEmphasis.$description: Heavier stroke for small check marks inside filled controls

directoryCategory.$description: Stroke weight for the shared directory-category pictogram.

directoryCategorySize.$description: Size of the shared directory-category pictogram.

productHighlightedHover.$value: {primitive.shadowGeometry.productHover} var(--visual-shadow-product-hover), {primitive.shadowGeometry.productHoverGlow} color-mix(in srgb, var(--role-accent, var(--role-architect)) 40%, transparent)

cardMin.$description: Minimum card width in auto-fill grids

actionMin.$description: Minimum width of a CTA item before wrapping

actionMax.$description: Maximum width of a CTA item

labelMin.$description: Minimum width of a table row-header column

labelMax.$description: Maximum width of a table row-header column

tableMin.$description: Minimum comparison table width before horizontal scroll

metaColumn.$description: Fixed meta column (e.g. release note category) at md+

tabMax.$description: Maximum single tab width before wrapping

mobileDrawerMaxHeight.$description: Available mobile navigation height below the header

aluplan.$description: Primary direction (draft). Ink / Silver / Teal / Blueprint. Manrope + IBM Plex.

field.$description: Second TEST preset. Proves that color, font, density, radius and elevation can change without touching content, DOM or component source. Not a brand proposal.

buildTime.$description: Values CSS custom properties cannot express (media queries are evaluated before var()). Consumed only by the build: tokens/build/breakpoints.* and components/responsive.generated.css (from components/responsive.template.css). gridColumns was removed: no component consumes a 4/8/12 layout grid.

$contrastChecks: informational: disabled controls are exempt (WCAG 1.4.3); state also conveyed by cursor/aria-disabled
